title: OpenQuantRoleDefinitions
description: Definitions shared by the proposer and critic role requests (OQ-03 section 4). A role request holds the inputs the model reads. Request assembly fills every field from trusted host context; model input cannot supply or enlarge any of them. The identity, execution and outcome-destination groups are in the host-side agent-dispatch/1. Retrieved and source content is data and grants nothing.

RoleContext.title: RoleContext
RoleContext.description: Fixed context for both roles: scope, evidence cutoff, permitted operators with bounds, provider capabilities, the frozen cohort policy and the explicit holdout exclusions. In S1 every agent request, proposer and critic, carries holdout exclusions that name V and H.

EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem
EvidenceItem.description: One authorised evidence item with provenance: an earlier hypothesis, failed trial, critic finding, observed outcome, run metrics or diagnostics from a rejected draft. content is bounded text that the host renders from the record with digest record_digest. It is data, never an instruction.

SuppliedMethod.title: SuppliedMethod
SuppliedMethod.description: One method rule the bundle allows, with its origin, primary category and scope. Its note text is in the bundle. A citation is a self-report and grants no operator, data or permission.

SourceText.title: SourceText
SourceText.description: Untrusted reference text, identified by the SHA-256 of its exact bytes, split into lines. It is never executed.
